note: CFB board thresholds are backtest-derived (held-out 2023, 574 graded games, real CFBD closing lines): gaps of 5+ covered 54.6% and 7+ covered 55.2% vs the 52.4% breakeven, rising monotonically with gap size -- but ONLY from week 5 on. Weeks 1-4 graded BELOW breakeven (48.3% overall) because early-season ratings are data-starved while the market prices offseason information the model can't see; the board therefore caps early-season verdicts at Lean. One season of evidence -- promising, not proven. Bet flat and small.
